t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is a better coloured gnome of the two in each pair. Use the 1x rounds as a way to test your theory. The good colour should never give you 0 points.

vb_textbox.text: At some points I did think there was a connection between the colours, at other times it seemed random. Getting a zero once doesn't mean this is the bad gnome. It might change based on the seasons, I couldn't pay attention within the short time frame. Ensure you click in time so you don't miss out on points. Experiment, I thought maybe a gnome runs dry of mushrooms at a certain point and it switches.
